about: Every problem a map can have, by code: what the viewer (map-viewer/model, reported as map-<code>) and the checker (format/check_map.py) say. level: what the checker does (error fails, warning passes); the viewer shows both as warnings. side: who reports it in a plain parse (both, checker, viewer). sample: false when no sample map can show it (format/samples/ shows every other). scripts/check.sh and the browser tests hold both sides to this list.

title-missing.what: No # title line before the first diagram

diagram-type.what: A block that is not a Mermaid mindmap, flowchart or sequenceDiagram

block-no-heading.what: A further Mermaid block with no heading of its own right above it

diagram-heading-twice.what: Two diagrams under the same heading

section-unknown.what: A ## heading that is no section of the format and starts no diagram

section-twice.what: A section that may appear once appears twice

emoji.what: An emoji in a label (icons go in ::icon or ## Node icons)

long-label.what: A label over 150 characters a line or 1,000 in all (the viewer shortens it)

large-map.what: Over 5,000 nodes: drawing may be slow

node-no-id.what: A mind map node written as bare text: valid, drawn, but nothing can refer to it

shape-unknown.what: Flowchart: brackets that are no Mermaid shape

mindmap-shape-unknown.what: Mind map: brackets that are no Mermaid shape (the viewer draws a plain node)

mindmap-orphan-line.what: An ::icon or ::: line before any node

mindmap-second-root.what: A second centre in a mind map

mindmap-duplicate-id.what: Two mind map nodes with one id (the viewer renames the second)

pin-side.what: A :::left / :::right pin on a node that is no main branch, or both pins

direction-unknown.what: A flowchart direction other than LR, RL, TB, TD, BT

flowchart-node-syntax.what: A flowchart node that cannot be read

flowchart-line-syntax.what: A flowchart line that cannot be read

subgraph-end-extra.what: An end with no subgraph open

subgraph-not-closed.what: A subgraph not closed with end

arrow-settings.what: An arrow's id@{ ... } settings: valid Mermaid, ignored

arrow-label-lines.what: An arrow's or message's label past two lines: two are drawn, the rest shows on hover

style-ignored.what: style or linkStyle: valid Mermaid, ignored (use classes and classDef)

click-callback.what: click with a callback: valid Mermaid, ignored (a map never runs code)

click-link-ignored.what: A click link that is not http(s), mailto or #<diagram>: ignored

click-unknown-node.what: click on an id that is no node

click-no-diagram.what: click "#anchor" naming no other diagram in the file

arrow-id-twice.what: One arrow id on two arrows in a block

arrow-id-several.what: An arrow id on an & arrow (it would name several)

arrow-id-is-node.what: An arrow id that is also a node's id

class-unknown-id.what: class on an id that is no node or arrow

class-unknown.what: A line class with no meaning (## Classes, built in) and no classDef: it does nothing

unknown-cloud-icon.what: An aws, azure or gcp icon name not in vendor-icons.json (the viewer leaves it out; the checker names the nearest)

unknown-icon.what: An icon code not in icons.json, the bundled Phosphor set or the map legend

icon-legend-syntax.what: An ## Icons line that cannot be read

icon-legend-name.what: An ## Icons name that is a named code or starts with ph-

icon-legend-unknown.what: An ## Icons line naming an unknown icon

class-line-syntax.what: A ## Classes line that cannot be read

plan-class-twice.what: A node or arrow given two different planned-change classes (added, changed, removed): the later is used

plan-class-reserved.what: A ## Classes line or classDef named added, changed or removed: those are built-in planned-change classes; the line is ignored

plan-arrow-contradicts.what: A planned change that contradicts itself: an arrow marked added ending on a removed node, or an arrow marked removed between two added nodes

plan-arrow-to-removed.what: An unmarked arrow touching a node marked removed: mark the arrow removed (or changed)

plan-removed-keeps.what: A box marked removed whose children are not all removed, and no note on it saying where they go

plan-all-removed.what: Everything inside a box marked removed, the box itself not marked

relation-syntax.what: A relation line that cannot be read

relation-unknown-node.what: A relation from or to a node that does not exist

cross-map-missing.what: A relation to another map that is not found, or to a node not in it (the viewer reports it when its host can read maps)

view-twice.what: Two relation views with one name

view-empty.what: A named relation view with no relations

note-no-anchor.what: A ### note with no <a id> anchor

note-unknown-id.what: A note for an id that is no node or arrow

node-icons-syntax.what: A ## Node icons line that cannot be read

node-icons-unknown-id.what: Node icons for an id that is no node or arrow

deployment-no-block.what: A ## Deployment: heading with no Mermaid block

deployment-no-name.what: A ## Deployment: heading naming no environment

deployment-type.what: A deployment's block that is not a flowchart

deployment-not-flowchart.what: Deployments under a diagram that is not a flowchart

deployment-view-name.what: An environment with the name of a relation view

deployment-unknown-id.what: A bare id in a deployment that is no node of the diagram

deployment-arrow-on-node.what: A deployment's arrow touching the diagram's nodes

deployment-out-of-step.what: A node placed in some environments and not others

deployment-inside-itself.what: A deployment placing a box inside itself (defensive: regrouping moves each box first)

diagram-unreachable.what: A further diagram no link leads to from the first (a click, a note link, a Plays over line); the viewer lists it as a view under Not linked

sequence-line-syntax.what: A sequenceDiagram line that is not understood, or a block or box not closed

message-id-twice.what: A message id (%% id:) used twice

message-id-no-message.what: A %% id: line not followed by a message

plays-over-syntax.what: A ## Plays over line that is not "- #<diagram anchor> : <view name>"

plays-over-unknown.what: A ## Plays over line naming no box diagram of the file, or no relation view of it

plays-over-not-sequence.what: A ## Plays over section after a diagram that is no sequence

sequence-not-in-view.what: A participant of a sequence that is no node the view it plays over shows

sequence-no-arrow.what: A message of a sequence with no arrow, either way, between its two ends in the view it plays over

state-line-syntax.what: A state diagram line that cannot be read

state-close-extra.what: A "}" with no composite state open

state-not-closed.what: A composite state not closed with "}"

state-region-top.what: "--" (a concurrent region) outside a composite state

state-mark-unknown.what: <<...>> that is not choice, fork or join

state-note-unknown.what: A note on a state that does not exist

state-note-open.what: A note not closed with "end note"

state-unreachable.what: A state no path from the start [*] reaches (only when the diagram has a start at the top)

state-dead-end.what: A state no transition leaves (nor a composite round it) that is no end [*]

er-line-syntax.what: An ER diagram line that cannot be read

er-attr-syntax.what: An entity's column that cannot be read (type name [PK, FK, UK] ["comment"])

er-not-closed.what: An entity's columns not closed with "}"

er-attr-twice.what: A column named twice in one entity

walks-not-here.what: A ## Walks: section after a diagram that is no state or ER diagram: not read

walk-syntax.what: A walk step that cannot be read (want "- A --> B : what happens")

walk-not-step.what: A walk step that is no transition (state) or relationship (ER) of the diagram

walk-gap.what: A walk step that does not start where the step before ended

walk-twice.what: Two walks of one diagram with the same name

look-not-flowchart.what: A ## Look: line on a diagram that is not a flowchart (only flowcharts have looks to choose)

look-twice.what: Two ## Look: lines for one diagram

look-unknown.what: A ## Look: value that is not one of a flowchart's looks (outline, poster)

main-icon-alone.what: The word main in an icon list with no icon after it

main-icon-arrow.what: The word main in an arrow's icons: an arrow has no main icon

main-icon-cloud.what: main before a cloud icon: the first cloud icon is main by its place, never marked

main-icon-mark.what: main before a trust mark or a status code: a main icon shows what the node is

main-icon-mind-map.what: main in a mind map's ::icon: a mind map has no main icon

main-icon-twice.what: Two icons marked main for one node or class

main-icon-with-cloud.what: An icon marked main on a node that has a cloud icon, its own or its class's (the cloud icon is main)
